# PHOTOBASH

> > High-quality reference photos, masked PNG assets, and 3D kits for digital artists, concept artists, and game developers.

PHOTOBASH is a curated collection of professional reference photography and digital assets designed for creative professionals. The platform offers masked PNG cutouts, high-resolution stock photography, and 3D modular kits across multiple categories including characters, environments, props, and effects, all available under commercial licenses.

## Key Topics

- Reference Photos
- Masked PNGs
- Digital Art Assets
- Concept Art Resources
- Stock Photography
- Commercial License
- High-Resolution Images
- 3D Kits
- Character References
- Environmental Assets
- Props Reference
- Visual Effects
- Digital Painting
- Matte Painting
- Creative Resources

## Core Collections

- [PHOTOBASH - Homepage](https://www.photobash.org): Homepage showcasing PHOTOBASH premium reference photos and masked PNG assets
- [FREE Photo Packs](https://www.photobash.org/free): Free photo packs and masked PNGs for artists and creatives
- [NATURE Photo Packs](https://www.photobash.org/nature): Nature photo packs featuring landscapes, mountains, and scenery
- [URBAN References](https://www.photobash.org/urban): Urban architectural references from Tokyo, Dubai, and Angkor
- [CHARACTER & CREATURE References](https://www.photobash.org/character): Character and creature reference photos with masked PNG assets
- [PROPS Photo Refs](https://www.photobash.org/props): Props reference photos including medieval, Viking, and Egyptian items

## Effects & 3D Assets

- [FX Stock Images](https://www.photobash.org/effects): Visual effects stock images including fire, dust, and LED effects
- [3D Kits](https://www.photobash.org/3d-kits): 3D modular kits for sci-fi cities, medieval towns, and fortresses
- [CLOUDS](https://www.photobash.org/clouds): Cloud reference photos with masked PNG assets for digital artists

## Environmental & Landscape Assets

- [DECIDUOUS TREES II](https://www.photobash.org/deciduous-trees-ii): High-resolution masked tree assets for digital art and matte painting
- [GRASS & WEEDS II](https://www.photobash.org/grass-weeds-ii): Foliage and grass reference assets with masked PNG cutouts
- [ARID MOUNTAINS](https://www.photobash.org/arid-mountains): Desert mountain landscape references from North American locations
- [JAGGED ROCKS](https://www.photobash.org/jagged-rocks): Jagged coastal rock formations reference from Japan

## Architecture & Structures

- [ANGKOR RUINS](https://www.photobash.org/angkor-ruins): Angkor Wat architectural reference photos from Cambodia
- [GOTHIC SPIRES](https://www.photobash.org/gothic-spires): Gothic architecture spires reference pack from European locations
- [GOTHIC RUINS II](https://www.photobash.org/gothic-ruins-ii): Gothic ruins reference photos from Scotland with masked PNG assets
- [ROOFTOP STRUCTURES II](https://www.photobash.org/rooftop-structures-ii): Industrial rooftop structures reference photos and masked assets

## Character & Creature References

- [MEDIEVAL VILLAGERS II](https://www.photobash.org/medieval-villagers-ii): Medieval villagers character reference pack with masked PNG assets
- [CAPED KNIGHTS](https://www.photobash.org/caped-knights): Knights and armor character reference photos with masked assets
- [DERELICT MARKET PROPS](https://www.photobash.org/derelict-market-props): Dystopian market props reference from India with masked assets
